facts: The public tourism page identifies Noksan-ro Canola Flower Road in Gasi-ri, Pyoseon, Seogwipo.
Its official tags include landscapes, spring, photospot, natural scenery, walking, drive, canola, and cherry blossom.
It calls Noksan-ro full of canola flowers one of Jeju's most beautiful spring photographs.
The KTO guide lists Noksan-ro Canola Flower Road as a recommended Jeju canola-flower destination.
It states the attraction is a free, year-round road in Gasi-ri and advises caution for vehicle traffic and road safety.

theme.mountain.hold_reason: The official sources identify a canola road and natural scenery, but do not directly describe mountain scenery or mountain activity.
theme.mountain.rationale: It is not a mountain activity destination, so only a weak contextual association is retained.

theme.ocean.rationale: The official description concerns an inland Gasi-ri canola road; it provides no coast or marine activity evidence.

theme.activity.rationale: Official tags include walking and driving, but no high-intensity or facility-based activity is evidenced.

theme.culture_history.hold_reason: The reviewed official sources lack direct historical or cultural-heritage interpretation.
theme.culture_history.rationale: The Gasi-ri location alone is insufficient to assign a high culture/history score.

theme.theme_park.rationale: It is an outdoor road and flower landscape, not a theme-park facility.

theme.cafe.rationale: The public tourism description identifies a flower-road attraction, not a cafe.

theme.traditional_market.rationale: No market or commerce function is identified; this is a road landscape attraction.

theme.festival.rationale: It is a spring flower attraction, but neither official source says a specific festival is the core visit purpose.

environment.indoor_ratio.rationale: Canola flowers line an outdoor road, and KTO's road-traffic safety advice confirms the outdoor road setting.

environment.weather_sensitivity.rationale: This is a fully outdoor spring landscape experienced by walking or driving, so weather directly affects the visit.

style_evidence.restfulness.rationale: The primary experience is slow viewing of spring natural scenery by walk or drive rather than dense commercial activity.

style_evidence.physical_ease.hold_reason: No official place-level evidence on walking distance, grade, or accessibility was found.
style_evidence.physical_ease.rationale: Road access alone does not establish pedestrian ease, so the neutral value is retained.

style_evidence.visit_duration_flexibilit.rationale: A road landscape supports a short drive/photo stop as well as a longer walk.

style_evidence.scenic_value.rationale: JTO explicitly presents canola-filled Noksan-ro as one of Jeju's most beautiful spring photographs and tags it as natural scenery.

style_evidence.distinctiveness.rationale: The combined canola, cherry-blossom, and road landscape is separately listed as a Jeju tourism attraction and photospot.

style_evidence.local_embeddedness.rationale: It is a Gasi-ri, Jeju spring landscape attraction centered on locally characteristic canola scenery.

style_evidence.landmark_significance.rationale: Both JTO and KTO officially feature it as a representative spring photograph or recommended canola destination.

style_evidence.photo_value.rationale: JTO calls it one of Jeju's most beautiful spring photographs and explicitly assigns the photospot tag.

derived_style.discovery_explorer.hold_reason: The existing derived rule has no place-specific input.
